title: Transition from the End of Rightward Growth
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-alphabet Turing machine, choose a source symbol $a_0$, and let $c$ be a source configuration on the retracted input. Let $q$ be a source state, and suppose the optional symbols in a table $s$ are exactly those scanned by the work-tape heads of $c$. For any integer frontier and zipper lists, one simulator step from the right-growth phase with counter $k$ yields the reflected zipper configuration in the writing phase, using the source transition's updated input-head position and output, moving the frontier from $z$ to $z-1$, and replacing the right list by the boundary marker followed by its previous tail.
hypotheses_covered: decidable equality on the source alphabet
a source configuration c on the retracted input
a table s whose optional symbols match c's scanned work-tape symbols
